name: NeRF-based Collision Probability Estimation
definition: Estimates collision probability by treating NeRF volume density as a proxy for the probability of a mass particle (robot body) stopping a ray. It assumes the probability of terminating a light ray is a strong proxy for terminating a mass particle.
summary: NeRF-based collision probability estimation uses neural radiance field volume density as a continuous proxy for collision likelihood, enabling smooth, differentiable cost terms for trajectory optimization without explicit mesh extraction.
